about: An event-mode policy reacts just after the API call it lists: the bullet says when it runs, and never that creation is blocked or denied.

controls.output: - RDS instances with `PubliclyAccessible` true are flagged just after `CreateDBInstance`, so the instance exists by then. Private instances pass. CRITICAL, ORG; reports only. acme:rds-public-on-create@1

- RDS instances with `PubliclyAccessible` true are flagged. Instances with `PubliclyAccessible` false pass. CRITICAL, ORG; runs shortly after `CreateDBInstance` calls, not on a schedule; reports only, so it does not block or change the instance. acme:rds-public-on-create@1
- Creating an RDS instance with `PubliclyAccessible` true is blocked. Private instances pass. CRITICAL, ORG; reports only. acme:rds-public-on-create@1
- RDS instances are flagged when `PubliclyAccessible` is true. Private instances pass. CRITICAL, ORG; reports only. acme:rds-public-on-create@1
- RDS instances with `PubliclyAccessible` true are flagged: creation is stopped at `CreateDBInstance`. Private instances pass. CRITICAL, ORG; reports only. acme:rds-public-on-create@1
- RDS instances with `PubliclyAccessible` true cannot be created: `CreateDBInstance` fails. Private instances pass. CRITICAL, ORG; reports only. acme:rds-public-on-create@1

- RDS instances with `PubliclyAccessible` true are flagged: the policy checks `CreateDBInstance` calls before the instance is created. Private instances pass. CRITICAL, ORG; reports only. acme:rds-public-on-create@1
- RDS instances with `PubliclyAccessible` true are flagged by a nightly scan, not on `CreateDBInstance`. Private instances pass. CRITICAL, ORG; reports only. acme:rds-public-on-create@1
